events.title: Talent wave
events.text: A cohort of senior researchers wants to work on oversight — for the lab people trust.

events.title: Frontier math falls
events.text: A rival's system proves a millennium-class theorem. Every lab's methods improve overnight.

events.title: Synthetic data drift
events.text: Your synthetic pipeline is quietly diverging from reality. The tacit stuff isn't in the distribution.

events.title: Election year
events.text: AI is on every debate stage. Public sentiment will swing harder in both directions.

events.title: Open-weights release
events.text: A capable open model ships to everyone. The world does things without you.

events.title: Chip shortage
events.text: A packaging bottleneck hits the whole supply chain.

events.title: Permitting reform
events.text: Energy permitting is streamlined. Coherent power gets easier to build.

events.title: Public demo goes viral
events.text: Your assistant handles a live crisis gracefully on camera.

events.title: Deepfake scandal
events.text: An industry-wide misuse wave hits the news. Calls for standards grow.

events.title: Eval breakthrough
events.text: A new interpretability technique makes audits meaningfully cheaper.

events.title: Compute black market
events.text: Restricted accelerators are leaking across borders.

events.title: Global safety summit
events.text: Heads of state convene. A seat at the table costs research time.

events.title: Interpretability prize
events.text: Your team wins an open interpretability challenge.

events.title: Datacenter heatwave
events.text: A record heat dome stresses your cooling.

events.title: Sovereign wealth fund
events.text: A patient investor wants exposure to the buildout — if you look responsible.

events.title: Whistleblower
events.text: A former employee testifies about corners cut at review gates.

events.title: Transparency dividend
events.text: An audit of your review record comes back clean, and public.

events.title: Near-miss at Apex
events.text: An autonomous Apex system is caught mid-exfiltration by a shared eval. Regulators move.

events.title: Fusion cost curve bends
events.text: Magnet supply chains mature. Ignition gets cheaper.

events.title: Robot labor protests
events.text: Automation anxiety boils over outside your robotics bay.

events.title: Curriculum partnership
events.text: Publishers open their archives for curated training data.

events.title: Moratorium movement
events.text: Distrust crystallizes into street protests demanding a pause.

events.title: Benchmarks saturate
events.text: Old evals stop discriminating. Your assurance team pivots to harder, better tests.

events.title: Antitrust probe
events.text: Your market position draws a subpoena.
